translations.web: “I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
translations.bsb: “I have heard the sayings of the prophets who prophesy lies in My name: ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
translations.kjv: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
